title: Boss Elegant: the shutter as part of the elevation
author: Finishing
excerpt: A shutter on a street frontage is a large flat surface at eye level. The Elegant range treats that as a finish problem rather than a hardware one.
body: A closed shutter on a street elevation is one of the largest flat surfaces on the building, and it sits at eye level. Treated as hardware it is grey; treated as elevation it is a colour decision.

The Elegant range is built for that: imported billet, the same section work as the rest of the range, and powder coating on the automatic line across a much wider palette — including the warm, low-saturation tones that read as architecture rather than as a security product.
Nothing else changes. The curtain, the latch and the operator are specified exactly as they would be on any other shutter of the same size; the range is a finish specification, not a different door.
